anomalies.description: A large group of people, some wearing yellow vests, are moving through a city street amid thick smoke and visible fires in the distance; the atmosphere suggests collective unrest with signs of property damage and confrontation.

In frame f7 (3.5s), two individuals appear to be engaged in close physical contact near the center-left; by f8 (4.0s), one person is seen raising an arm toward another in proximity, consistent with a scuffle or shove, though obscured by motion and low light.

A large group of people wearing yellow vests is marching down a Parisian street, with thick black smoke rising in the background indicating fire or burning debris; individuals are moving purposefully, some raising arms in gestures associated with protest, and the overall scene shows collective unrest consistent with a riot.
